distinct_id.description: Distinct ID of the person to notify. The notification goes to every device this person registered for the template's push channels. A person with no registered device gets nothing, and the send shows as skipped in the template's sends. The template can't read the person's properties, so pass everything it needs in `message_data`.

message_data.description: Values for the template's {{ variables.* }} placeholders, keyed by variable name.

template_id.description: ID of a push template made transactional, which holds the notification's title, body and push channels.
